name: Cluster Architecture, Installation & Configuration
description: Design, install, configure, and manage Kubernetes clusters and cluster components.
descriptionMm: Kubernetes cluster များနှင့် cluster components များကို ဒီဇိုင်းဆွဲခြင်း၊ တပ်ဆင်ခြင်း၊ ပြင်ဆင်သတ်မှတ်ခြင်းနှင့် စီမံခန့်ခွဲခြင်း။
competencies: Manage role based access control (RBAC)
Prepare underlying infrastructure for installing a Kubernetes cluster
Create and manage Kubernetes clusters using kubeadm
Manage the lifecycle of Kubernetes clusters
Implement and configure a highly-available control plane
Use Helm and Kustomize to install cluster components
Understand extension interfaces (CNI, CSI, CRI, etc.)
Understand CRDs, install and configure operators
examVersionNote: Based on CNCF CKA Curriculum v1.37 / Linux Foundation CKA competencies (exam environment aligned to recent Kubernetes minor versions).

name: Workloads & Scheduling
description: Deploy and manage applications and configure scheduling behavior.
descriptionMm: Application များကို deploy လုပ်ခြင်း၊ စီမံခြင်းနှင့် scheduling behavior များကို ပြင်ဆင်သတ်မှတ်ခြင်း။
competencies: Understand application deployments and how to perform rolling update and rollbacks
Use ConfigMaps and Secrets to configure applications
Configure workload autoscaling
Understand the primitives used to create robust, self-healing, application deployments
Configure Pod admission and scheduling (limits, node affinity, etc.)

name: Services & Networking
description: Configure networking, service exposure, and traffic management for cluster workloads.
descriptionMm: Cluster workloads များအတွက် networking, service exposure နှင့် traffic management ကို ပြင်ဆင်သတ်မှတ်ခြင်း။
competencies: Understand connectivity between Pods
Define and enforce Network Policies
Use ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer service types and endpoints
Use the Gateway API to manage Ingress traffic
Know how to use Ingress controllers and Ingress resources
Understand and use CoreDNS

name: Storage
description: Provision and manage storage resources for stateful workloads.
descriptionMm: Stateful workloads များအတွက် storage resources များကို provision လုပ်ခြင်းနှင့် စီမံခြင်း။
competencies: Implement storage classes and dynamic volume provisioning
Configure volume types, access modes and reclaim policies
Manage persistent volumes and persistent volume claims

name: Troubleshooting
description: Diagnose and resolve issues across applications, nodes, control plane, networking, and cluster services.
descriptionMm: Applications, nodes, control plane, networking နှင့် cluster services များတွင် ဖြစ်ပေါ်သော ပြဿနာများကို ရှာဖွေဖော်ထုတ်ပြီး ဖြေရှင်းခြင်း။
competencies: Troubleshoot clusters and nodes
Troubleshoot cluster components
Monitor cluster and application resource usage
Manage and evaluate container output streams
Troubleshoot services and networking
